notes.title: ZomWick Demo Released
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551826/4901248fc14a60dc8570373e8a0bb13227504744.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

We're excited to announce that we've completed a demo version of the game, allowing you to try it out before making a purchase. We're committed to avoiding predatory sales practices. If you enjoy the demo and are genuinely interested in playing and supporting the game, we encourage you to consider buying it. However, if it's likely to just gather dust in your Steam library, we'd prefer you didn't make a purchase. 


People often say that publishing games is a challenging endeavor, and they're absolutely right. What we've found, though, is that publishing demos can be even more demanding. Maintaining two different versions of the game becomes cumbersome very quickly.

So, please keep these in mind while playing the demo:

[list]
 [*]   The demo may lag behind the real game in terms of features and could be drastically different from the full game.
[*]    It may include bugs that have already been fixed in the full game.
[*]    It could also have additional features[b](*)[/b] that the main game does not have.
[/list]






[b]* Disclaimer: [/b]The demo features a leaderboard where you can compete for the best time, but please note that this feature is exclusive to the demo and is not included in the full game.

notes.title: Build 1.0.10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changelog
[list]
[*]Increased performance in Main Menu
[*]Fixed "Resume Game" panel animation
[*]Reduced timer for Level "Cube 2". It is now possible to win without using "Tower Suicide" mechanics. 
[*] The bullet size has been increased, making it harder to miss ZomWick.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.1.34 Testing Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]     All levels are open for testing purposes. Normal game player will start from level 1 in "The Void"
[*]     Steam features will NOT work in Play Testing Branch. You can request keys for Main Branch.
[*]     There will be some minor problems in some levels. Some of them may be impossible to win. We hope you will  be understanding about this errors but we still welcome any feedback no matter how small or how hot it is!
[*]     If you want to ask anything about game or want to report bugs you can reach us from the icons in the right of "Main Menu"
[/list]
